name: External re-test of the frozen joint graders J and J-crop on DDR and IDRiD

models.p: ImageNet ConvNeXt-Tiny + CORN, APTOS only; stored predictions reused, not run
models.p_ep: EyePACS-adapted encoder, APTOS fine-tuned; stored predictions reused, not run

pipeline.crop: Stage 2 once, cut to the fundus box (rule of record 89), resize to 512
pipeline.inference: the parent protocol's settings (T4, mixed_float16, batch 8); CORN decode at 0.5; no TTA, no threshold fitting, no recalibration

populations.ddr: the pinned lists of ddr_grading_protocol_v1.json: primary 3,540; broader 3,725 as sensitivity
populations.idrid: the 103 images of idrid_grading_protocol.json: primary 100; all 103 as sensitivity

comparisons.standing: the two main contrasts have equal standing; neither joint arm is the pre-declared final model
comparisons.multiplicity: two main contrasts per dataset; intervals are not adjusted for multiplicity and are reported as such

analysis.main_estimate: for each joint arm: mean over the three seed-labelled pairs of QWK(arm) - QWK(P), on each dataset's primary population
analysis.reading: for each main contrast separately: supported if the 95 % interval lies wholly above zero; reversed if wholly below; otherwise no difference shown. Seed-level inconsistency is flagged when any of the three differences is not positive
analysis.pairing: every model is scored on the same images in the same order; seed-labelled pairs (42, 123, 2026); one set of bootstrap resamples is applied to all tables of a population
analysis.also_reported: per-seed and mean QWK, per-cut AUROC, per-grade recall, referable-DR sensitivity and specificity, ECE, seed ensemble; on DDR both main contrasts inside each file-name family

what_is_fixed_beforehand: the six checkpoints: BEST by the mean of the APTOS and EyePACS validation QWK, chosen during training (records 97, 98)
the decode: CORN, cumulative probability above 0.5; no threshold is fitted on any external image
the preprocessing of each arm: unchanged from training (direct resize, or the record-89 crop rule)
the populations and their exclusions: those of the earlier protocols, unchanged
P and P-EP: their stored predictions, unchanged
disclosures: This is a re-use of both test sets: DDR was used once for grading (record 86), IDRiD three times (records 61, 67, 79).
The earlier results on both sets were known when joint training was chosen; the audits that led to it drew on DDR's failure pattern.
No setting of J or J-crop was chosen on either set; both were trained and selected on APTOS and EyePACS development data only.

Neither joint arm is pre-declared primary (user decision, 2026-10-14, replacing the J-primary declaration of record 94). If one arm is later chosen as the final model from these results, that choice is post hoc and the chosen arm's external estimate is optimistically biased.
The EyePACS held-out test is not read by this evaluation.
P's batch size was 2 and the joint models' 16: J - P confounds joint data with batch size.
On DDR, file-name family is tied to grade; DDR has no patient identifiers; intervals are conditional on the fixed checkpoints.
No clinical-utility, equivalence or non-inferiority claim is made.
rules: a rerun only for a technical failure, with the reason recorded
